name: drk_vssl_anchorages_v0
description: APPROXIMATE initial anchorage / harbour / OPL masks for the Eastern OPL AOI [1.2,104.0]-[2.6,105.5]. Hand-drawn boxes, NOT official MPA or Marine Department Malaysia limits. Clipped to lon >= 104.0, so Singapore's main Eastern Anchorage (AEW, ~103.87-103.95E) is outside the AOI. Coordinates are [lon, lat], WGS84. Check against official charts and ping-density heatmaps before relying on them.
